reviews_captured_by_me.text:
Thank you, Mike Davis of Davis Renovations LLC, for an excellent job replacing the tub and shower surround in one of my rental properties. He did a great job, the finished bathroom looks fantastic, and the price was very fair. It was a smooth experience from start to finish.

As a rental property owner, it’s important to have contractors you can trust to deliver quality work on time and at a reasonable cost. Mike has earned my confidence, and I won’t hesitate to use Davis Renovations LLC again for future projects.

— Steve Moulton
Amber Ridge Properties LLC

Mike did an excellent job installing the door. His workmanship was high-quality, detail-oriented, and completed efficiently. He was very easy to work with—professional, respectful, and clear in his communication throughout the process. The final result looks great and functions perfectly. I would highly recommend Mike to anyone looking for reliable and skilled work, and I will definitely have him do work for me again.

My husband and I met Michael recently, when a professional we hired to fix our tub, left us with more of a problem than we started with.  My husband found Michael’s business online and called him to see if there was anything he could do to help us.  Michael arrived that very same day and listened compassionately as we talked to him about the stressful experience we had.  He spent a good deal of time with us, offering us advice and a kind ear.  He put us in contact with a business associate of his who could help us with our particular tub problem, assuring us he would stay part of the project to make sure everything went well.  We feel grateful and blessed to have had this positive experience.
